UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd venice-unleashed && mkdir -p client bf3 instance/Admin instance/logs"
-c "export WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win32 WINEDEBUG=-all; if [ ! -f \"$WINEPREFIX/system.reg\" ]; then wineboot --init; wineserver -w; fi"

-c "export WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win32 WINEDEBUG=-all; cd venice-unleashed; if command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null; then xvfb-run -a wine vcredist_x86.exe /q; else wine vcredist_x86.exe /q; fi; wineserver -w; rm -f vcredist_x86.exe"

-c "cd venice-unleashed/instance/Admin && if [ ! -s MapList.txt ]; then for m in 'MP_Subway ConquestLarge0 1' 'MP_001 ConquestLarge0 1' 'MP_003 ConquestLarge0 1' 'MP_007 ConquestLarge0 1' 'XP1_001 ConquestAssaultLarge0 1'; do echo $m; done > MapList.txt; fi; [ -f ModList.txt ] || : > ModList.txt; [ -f Startup.txt ] || : > Startup.txt"
